data.one_liner: Flutter repository containing Enefty Icon Pack with Outline and Bold styles.
data.what_it_does: Provides the Enefty icon set created by Pickolab Studio for use in Flutter applications. It includes two icon styles (Outline and Bold) and supports standard Flutter Icon widgets.
use_when: You want to use the Enefty Icon Pack designed by Pickolab Studio in your Flutter app
You need standard outline and bold icon styles across multiple platforms
avoid_when: You require Material Design or Cupertino specific system icons
You need vector images outside of the provided Enefty icon set
strengths: Contains both Outline and Bold icon styles
Simple integration with Flutter's Icon widget
Includes proper RTL/LTR support for directional arrows
weaknesses: Limited to the specific Enefty Icon Pack asset set
Not documented for dynamic loading of external vector assets
